text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Brewer Horden a.s. has launched a 120 million crown tranche of five-year bonds with a 14 percent fixed annual coupon.
- Local money market dealers expect interbank interest rates to range between 20 and 26 percent in coming days.

SME - The opposition said round table discussions between all parliamentary parties on Friday ended without any significant result and added they saw no reason for organising similar talks in the near future.

- Slovakia is considering replacing import deposits with an import surcharge. Bratislava plans to present the import surcharge at bilateral talks with the European Union scheduled to start on July 9 in Bratislava.
- The Constitutional Court is expected to rule this week on an appeal by Jozef Gaulider, a former parliametary deputy, against his expulsion from parliament last autumn.
- Opposition deputies have appealed to the Constitutional Court against a government plan to regulate wage increases.
- Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said Russia reaffirmed its intention to accept Slovak goods as payment for gas supplies.

- Moscow will stick to its commitment to repay a $160 million tranche of its debt to Slovakia by the end of this year, Kozlik said after a four-day visit to Russia. Part of the debt should be repaid by deliveries of various products, including four TU-154 airplanes.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovakia's grain production is expected to total some 3.8 million tonnes this year, up from last year's 3.3 million tonnes.
- Slovakia's food and agricultural industry posted a 12.6 million crown foreign trade deficit in 1996.
SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - Deputy Foreign Minister Jozef Sestak has rejected information that he is planning to resign.
